name: approve-without-a-request-sends-yes
description: In built-in mode with no permission request waiting, Approve sends the word Yes to the harness as an ordinary user turn, logged as the person's own message.
reason: The built-in Claude adapter never asks for permission through PowerUp: Claude asks in its reply, and Approve answers it in words. Only a waiting permission request (built-in) or remote mode (Enter) turns Approve into something else.
source: DESIGN.md v1.0 '✕ → approve: "Yes" as a user turn'; AppState.approve

script.reason: Nothing is waiting for an answer, so Approve says Yes.
